# CANDIDATE: OPENING_RANGE_VOLATILITY_COMPRESSION_BREAKOUT

**Filed:** 2026-07-09
**Filer:** chef-nemotron (free-tier autonomous R&D)
**Type:** new_trigger
**Status:** DRAFT (NEEDS-RATIFICATION per Rule 9)

## Hypothesis

A narrow opening range (first 30 minutes) indicates low volatility and compression. A breakout above the opening range high with expanding volume signals an imminent directional move. Entering long at the close of the breakout bar captures the early momentum while limiting risk via a chart stop at the opening range low.

## Mechanism

Calculate the opening range (OR) high and low from the first 30 minutes of RTH (09:30-10:00 ET). If (OR_high - OR_low) / OR_midpoint ≤ 0.0025 (0.25% volatility compression) AND the current bar breaks above OR_high with volume ≥ 1.8 × average volume of the first 30 minutes AND the bar closes above the breakout level, enter long at the bar’s close. Stop is placed at OR_low (chart stop). TP1 is set at 1.5× initial risk (entry - stop). After TP1, the remaining position trails using a chandelier exit (ATR × 3). Regime filters: only consider when VIX < 20 and time ≥ 10:00 ET; avoid when VIX > 25 or during major economic releases.
